mapper.select: SELECT s_start.name AS departure, s_end.name AS arrival, s_start.code AS departureCode, s_end.code AS arrivalCode, s_start.id AS departureStationId, s_end.id AS arrivalStationId, tss_a.departure_time AS departureTime, tss_b.arrival_time AS arrivalTime, tss_a.sequence AS departureSequence, tss_b.sequence AS arrivalSequence FROM train_stop_station tss_a INNER JOIN train_stop_station tss_b ON tss_a.train_id = tss_b.train_id AND tss_a.sequence < tss_b.sequence INNER JOIN station s_start ON tss_a.station_id = s_start.id INNER JOIN station s_end ON tss_b.station_id = s_end.id WHERE tss_a.train_id = #{trainId} AND s_start.code = #{departureCode} AND s_end.code = #{arrivalCode}
